description: This file defines a global exception handler for a Spring Boot application, managing various exceptions and returning structured API error responses.

classes.name: GlobalExceptionHandler
classes.description: A class annotated with @RestControllerAdvice that handles exceptions thrown by controllers in the application and returns structured API error responses.

methods.name: handleValidation
methods.description: Handles validation errors resulting from invalid method arguments, returning a 400 Bad Request with details about field errors.

methods.name: handleAccessDenied
methods.description: Handles access denied exceptions, returning a 403 Forbidden response.

methods.name: handleNotFound
methods.description: Handles entity not found exceptions, returning a 404 Not Found response.

methods.name: handleConflict
methods.description: Handles data integrity violation exceptions, returning a 409 Conflict response.

methods.name: handleBadRequest
methods.description: Handles illegal argument exceptions, returning a 400 Bad Request response.

methods.name: handleGeneric
methods.description: Handles all other exceptions, returning a 500 Internal Server Error response.
